te: Battle of the Kondurcha River: Timur defeats Tokhtamysh of the Golden Horde in present-day southeast Russia.
dz: 托克塔米什-蒂穆尔战争:孔杜尔查河战役:蒂穆尔在当今俄罗斯东南部击败了金色霍尔德人的托克塔米什.
de: Tokhtamysh–Timur war: Battle of the Kondurcha River: Timur defeats Tokhtamysh of the Golden Horde in present-day southeast Russia.

de: A draft Byzantine–Venetian treaty is concluded between Venetian envoys and Emperor Michael VIII Palaiologos, but is not ratified by Doge Reniero Zeno.
